Under the direction of the program leader, you will work alongside the team on the following:

Participating in the draft and/or review of additional study documents through the end of the internship.

Pass a drug screening
Curiosity and a passion for clinical research are a must
Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills are a must
Strong written and oral communication skills are a must
